title: Send feedback
intro: Pick a couple of options and tell us — we capture the rest automatically.
bugPlaceholder: What went wrong? What did you expect to happen?
includeLogHint: Amounts, names and contact details are removed. Without this we often can't tell what went wrong on a phone.
autoIncluded: Automatically included: app version, current page, device, and connection status.
thanksBugBody: Beta testers who report 5 bugs get a free month of Lite, and 25 unlock Pro — your reward coupon shows up in Settings → Billing.
thanksSuggestionBody: We read every suggestion — thanks for helping shape Sanvya.
